title: Crypto Algo System: 74 pairs, 8.2k+ backtest trades. Feedback needed.
author: Ok-Notice-33
selftext:
Hello everyone,

I would like to get technical feedback from experienced algo traders and quantitative researchers regarding a crypto trading system I have been developing.

Current validation results:

• 74 cryptocurrency pairs

• 8,200+ historical trades

• Multiple timeframes (1H, 2H, 4H)

• Profit Factor between 1.9 and 2.5

• Maximum Drawdown between 5% and 8%

• Spot trading only

• Fully automated logic

The system has gone through several iterations and the recent versions have improved both Profit Factor and Drawdown metrics.

I am currently entering the paper trading stage and I am looking for constructive criticism, validation advice, and technical discussion from people experienced in:

• Algorithmic Trading

• Quantitative Research

• Risk Management

• Forward Testing

• Strategy Validation

I am not selling anything, not offering signals, and not looking for investors.

My goal is simply to learn from experienced traders, challenge my assumptions, identify possible weaknesses in the testing process, and improve the validation methodology before moving further.

I would appreciate any technical feedback or questions.

Thank you.
